facts.text: Through the Davidson Trust, Davidson admits students regardless of family financial circumstances and meets 100 percent of calculated financial need through grants and campus employment, without loans.

sources.title: Financial Aid Policies & Resources - Davidson College
sources.quote: We proudly stand as one of only two dozen schools in the United States that admit students independent of their family's ability to pay, meet 100 percent of calculated need and do so without loans in their aid package.
